project: SIH 2026 Landslide Early Warning & Risk Monitoring (Meghalaya)

section26b_arithmetic_verification.date_ranges_per_year: March 1 to October 31 (March 1 to July 31 for 2026)

option_1_full_season.description: Full March-October seasonal coverage across all 17 event years
option_1_full_season.scientific_justification: Optimal: Guarantees complete, unbiased climatological sampling across all 17 years; eliminates inter-annual selection bias.

option_2_event_years_season.description: Full March-October season for the 8 years containing April/May/October events
option_2_event_years_season.scientific_justification: Moderate: Covers all seasonal months for years with non-monsoon landslide triggering.

option_3_minimal_targeted.description: Strict minimal 30-day antecedent windows for April, May, and October in 8 specific event years
option_3_minimal_targeted.scientific_justification: Mathematical Minimum: Sufficient to generate quotas (69 April dates, 121 May dates, 20 Oct dates), but restricts background to landslide-active years.
